_comment: Effective settings for the scheduled cja_cj export. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every key here is optional; anything omitted falls back to the defaults in lib/config.js. Relative paths resolve against the project root, never the working directory. Any value can be overridden at run time with an SFEXPORT_* environment variable (see README).
_comment_paths: Where things live. Keep exports and logs off a synced/OneDrive folder: they contain customer configuration.
_comment_layout: per-org = one stable folder per org, replaced every run, so the export root always shows the current state of each org and nothing accumulates. No history: once tonight succeeds, last night is gone. per-run = a new timestamped folder each run, keeping history, pruned by exportRetentionDays. Either way the run exports into a temp folder and only swaps it into place on success, so a failed export never damages the folder already there. Tokens for orgFolderPattern: {alias} {orgId} {username} {usernamePrefix}.
_comment_cli: Leave sfExecutable blank to resolve sf from PATH. On a machine where the scheduled account has a thin PATH, set the full path instead. sfCliEntry is the faster and safer option when you can find the CLI's run.js: it bypasses the sf.cmd shim so no shell is involved at all.
_comment_what: What gets exported. integrationType is applied to every org; any-to-any additionally exports cja_cj__Dataflow__c. connectorFilter [] means every connector. queryLimit must stay <= 200: Salesforce requires LIMIT <= 200 on FIELDS(ALL) queries.
_comment_appcheck: Before running a full export we describe one packaged object. Metadata only, so an org with the package installed but zero records is still exported. Set enabled=false to export every reachable scratch org.
_comment_orgfilter: Empty include lists mean 'every discovered scratch org'. minHoursUntilExpiry skips orgs that would expire mid-run; 0 skips only orgs that have already expired.
_comment_perorg: Deterministic per-org overrides, keyed by username or alias. Use this instead of inferring settings per org. Example: { "test-abc@example.com": { "integrationType": "salesforce-to-any" }, "qa-sandbox-clone": { "skip": true, "reason": "owned by QA, exported separately" } }
_comment_execution: Sequential by design. maxRetries applies ONLY to failures the child classified as transient (exit code 6) or to a child we timed out; deterministic failures are never retried.
_comment_housekeeping: Retention is enforced at the end of each run. 0 disables pruning. exportRetentionDays applies ONLY to layout per-run; under per-org each org keeps exactly one folder and nothing is pruned.
